title: X-FORGE Docker property-output registry
description: Human-readable registry of every property listed in starting_text.txt. Property identifiers remain under their producing model. Only direct measurements or defensible mechanistic proxies participate in the two shared MOO objectives; safety and developability liabilities are constraints instead.

registry_semantics.classifier_values: Unless a model entry says otherwise, a classifier value is the probability of the named positive class. A 0.5 cutoff is a screening default, not a clinical safety guarantee.
registry_semantics.regression_values: Regression units are model-specific. Normalize within each property before combining models; never average raw logS, logP, kcal/mol, percent, or clearance.
registry_semantics.context_matters: BBB penetration, half-life, clearance, volume of distribution, and kinase activity can be desirable or undesirable depending on the therapeutic program.
registry_semantics.evidence_limit: These are computational predictions and descriptors. Thresholds are early-stage gates that require experimental confirmation and applicability-domain checks.

adverse_probability.note: Default gate for probabilities where the positive class is an adverse event.

favorable_probability.note: Default gate for probabilities where the positive class is desirable.

native_nontoxic_binary.note: CToxPred defines 0 as non-toxic and 1 as toxic.

molecular_weight_oral.note: Lipinski-style early oral-drug screen; not a universal modality limit.

qed_druglike.note: A practical project default, not a formal regulatory cutoff.

ld50_low_concern.note: Converts ADMET-AI's log10(1/(mol/kg)) prediction to mass dose and applies the GHS boundary above Category 4. Use only as a rat acute-oral screen.

lipophilicity.note: Lipophilicity is not "more is better." Normalize each direct logP/logD-like estimate, reward a project-configurable window, and avoid overweighting a molecule merely because several models estimate the same endpoint.

solubility.note: Direct logS predictions carry full weight. Hydration free energy is a mechanistic proxy and must carry lower weight because crystal-lattice energy, ionization, pH, temperature, and solid form also control measured solubility.
solubility.hydration_relationship: More-negative hydration free energy means more favorable transfer from gas to water. Therefore -HydrationFreeEnergy_FreeSolv increases with favorable hydration and is positively associated with solubility, but is not directly proportional to total aqueous solubility.
